## Strategic Advisory Committee

<!--
COORDINATOR: SAC is AUTO-GENERATED from data/team-members.csv

To add/update members:
1. Open Google Sheet with team member data
2. Add/edit rows where strategic_advisory_cmt is NOT "NA" or blank
3. The sync script will update data/team-members.csv automatically

CSV Columns needed: first_name, last_name, post_nominal_initials, affiliation_primary,
affiliation_2, affiliation_3, affiliation_4, strategic_advisory_cmt, ORCID, web_bio
-->

Our Strategic Advisory Committee provides expert guidance on the development and implementation of POPCORN-NCD reporting guidelines. Members represent diverse geographical regions, methodological expertise, and stakeholder perspectives.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Filter for SAC members (where strategic_advisory_cmt is not NA or empty)
sac <- team %>%
  filter(!is.na(strategic_advisory_cmt) &
         strategic_advisory_cmt != "" &
         strategic_advisory_cmt != "NA") %>%
  # Create sort order: Chair → Members → Ex Officio → PIs → Staff
  mutate(
    role_order = case_when(
      grepl("Chair", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 1,
      grepl("Member", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 2,
      grepl("Ex Officio", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 3,
      grepl("Principal Investigator|Co-Principal", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 4,
      grepl("Staff", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 6  # Catch-all for any other roles
    )
  ) %>%
  # Sort by role order, then alphabetically by last name
  arrange(role_order, last_name)

if (nrow(sac) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="team-list">\n\n')

  for (i in 1:nrow(sac)) {
    # Start member div
    cat('<div class="team-member">\n\n')

    # Left column: Name and credentials
    cat('<div class="member-name-col">\n')
    cat(sac$first_name[i], ' ', sac$last_name[i], '\n', sep='')
    if (!is.na(sac$post_nominal_initials[i]) && sac$post_nominal_initials[i] != "") {
      cat('<div class="member-credentials">', sac$post_nominal_initials[i], '</div>\n', sep='')
    }
    cat('</div>\n\n')

    # Right column: Details
    cat('<div class="member-details-col">\n\n')

    # Affiliations (combine non-empty affiliations with semicolons)
    affiliations <- c(
      sac$affiliation_primary[i],
      sac$affiliation_2[i],
      sac$affiliation_3[i],
      sac$affiliation_4[i]
    )
    affiliations <- affiliations[!is.na(affiliations) & affiliations != ""]

    if (length(affiliations) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-affiliation">', paste(affiliations, collapse='; '), '</div>\n\n', sep='')
    }

    # SAC role (just the role name, not full description)
    if (!is.na(sac$strategic_advisory_cmt[i]) && sac$strategic_advisory_cmt[i] != "") {
      cat('<div class="member-role">', sac$strategic_advisory_cmt[i], '</div>\n\n', sep='')
    }

    # Links (ORCID and Web bio)
    links <- character(0)

    if (!is.na(sac$ORCID[i]) && sac$ORCID[i] != "" && sac$ORCID[i] != "NA") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="https://orcid.org/', sac$ORCID[i], '"><img src="assets/icons/orcid.svg" class="inline-icon" alt="ORCID"> ORCID</a>'))
    }

    if (!is.na(sac$web_bio[i]) && sac$web_bio[i] != "") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="', sac$web_bio[i], '">Web bio</a>'))
    }

    if (length(links) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-links">', paste(links, collapse=' '), '</div>\n', sep='')
    }

    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close details column
    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close member div
  }

  cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close team-list
} else {
  cat('*Members to be announced.*\n\n')
}
```
